confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sri Lankan tourist-town price levels, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are somewhat more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely with season, room type and tourist demand. Sri Lankan rupee prices have been volatile, so USD figures may drift. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA overview page, which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct comparable city was used. The basis is general knowledge of Sri Lanka's Cultural Triangle tourist towns (such as Dambulla and Kandy) and of local restaurant and guesthouse pricing. July is in the dry-zone dry season, so it is not treated as off-season.
